subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should agent deletion fail closed before config removal whenever owned cron teardown cannot be confirmed, including the offline CLI fallback?
rationale: This choice changes established deletion and offline-recovery behavior: proceeding can leave recurring work active after its agent disappears, while failing closed can prevent deletion during scheduler or Gateway outages.

options.title: Fail closed before deletion
options.body: Require confirmed or durably retryable cron teardown before removing agent config, and block the offline fallback when owned schedules cannot be safely handled.

options.title: Permit best-effort deletion
options.body: Allow agent deletion to proceed during scheduler failures, but explicitly accept orphaned-job risk and provide a tested Doctor repair and operator-visible warning path.

recommendation.title: Fail closed before deletion
recommendation.body: Require confirmed or durably retryable cron teardown before removing agent config, and block the offline fallback when owned schedules cannot be safely handled.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and reproduced the exact deletion-ordering and retry-safety contract affected by this decision.
